releaseNotes: Share sends an image now: the Share button shares an actual linescore-board image (teams, inning columns, runs and hits at the far right) as a PNG through the system share sheet, with an on-screen image fallback. Every resolved at-bat cycles to the next batter exactly once: fixed forced-runner resolutions that never advanced (game stuck on the hitter) and scoring hits that advanced twice (skipped a batter). Undo is one logical action: one undo of a hit puts the hitter back at the plate with a fresh count; undoing a strike leaves the same batter up; undoing a walk returns the walked batter to the plate. Lineup menu: tapping a player name jumps to that batter (fresh count, undoable). No other gameplay changes.
